scope: Enforce explicitly configured output limits on the official DeepSeek endpoint using the existing LiveKit adapter. Measure PTT resource teardown separately from ASR final and reply start. No deployment.
production_changes: Only SharedStageFactory._build_llm: official api.deepseek.com endpoint maps the existing max_completion_tokens configuration to max_tokens using native extra_body passthrough. OpenAI and unknown proxy endpoints retain their existing contract. No default reply cap, SDK source, PTT orchestration, or connection-close lifecycle changes.
comparison_limits: One paired same-prompt probe, no population latency or causal attribution to the earlier PTT completion timeout. Provider usage establishes the cap violation independently of reply character counts.

ptt_teardown_finding.meaning: Task completion is already confirmed; graceful connection close is on the one-shot transcription return path. Do not conflate this with semantic endpoint waiting. The continuous full/half duplex recognition path does not close per user turn.

remaining: Earlier PTT 45-second whole-reply timeout lacked first-audio/usage data; cannot establish its exact cause from later passing runs.
Moving PTT connection teardown out of reply admission needs explicit lifecycle ownership and cancellation/new-turn/shutdown verification; teardown behavior is unchanged in this batch.
This batch covers generic synthetic WAVs with tempo changes, not natural variation across real speakers. Real audio output is a memory sink, not RTC/device playout.
No production RPC/RTC/device or complex-answer quality acceptance. Known EOT and none-provider semantic xfails remain.
The 96-token limit is explicit test configuration, not a newly imposed production default; ending at the budget is not a guarantee of complete or useful answer content.
